description: Techos de latencia (p95, ms, medida en el cliente) de la fase `performance` del certificador e-commerce (scripts/e2e-staging/ecommerce/phases/performance.mjs), uno por destino. NO se inventan: cada bloque sale de una corrida medida, con la regla de abajo, y se versiona a mano después de mirarlo. Un destino con `null` todavía no tiene compuerta: la fase mide, contesta MEASURED_NO_GATE y deja en performance.json el bloque propuesto (`gate.proposed`) para copiar acá. Con un bloque presente, cada p95 medido se compara contra su techo y la compuerta es PASS o FAIL; un techo versionado que la corrida no midió es FAIL.

rule.cap: statement_timeout of the role that makes the call (anon 3 s; authenticated 8 s; service_role through authenticator, 8 s). A ceiling equal to the timeout is listed under at_timeout: that call would already be failing, so it says nothing about performance and has to be looked at before committing.

operations.catalog_read: anon: the storefront shelf query (products, storefront columns and filters)
operations.order_creation_cash: authenticated customer: create_order_with_items, cash pickup (validation, intake guard, stock decrement and order in one transaction: the stock commit of the cash door)
operations.order_query: authenticated customer: the storefront order history (orders with order_items)
operations.tracking_query: anon with the order token: get_public_order_tracking
operations.panel_query: authenticated operator: the Panel inbox query of the order repository
operations.checkout_creation: service_role (what the Edge Function calls): create_checkout_session, stock reserved
operations.stock_commit_paid: service_role: finalize_paid_checkout_session (the reservation becomes the order)

steps: baseline (sequential) and c10, c30, c100 (Staging: c10 and c30 only, it is shared)
